summary: Independent Luna review rejected 8f037dae with two high and two medium security/correctness findings: source digest/reopen TOCTOU during root installation, incomplete runner-6252 proof, potentially blocking special-file opens in the offline verifier, and a stale conflicting fixture digest. The root-capable lifecycle and live evidence gates also remain unverified.
validation: Independent findings-first review completed against exact commit 8f037dae and the 12-requirement feature spec.
Reviewer inspected installer source capture, workflow identity, descriptor open semantics, and fixture/package consistency.
blockers: REV-001 HIGH: install.sh validates source digests then reopens mutable paths for root installation, permitting replacement between check and copy.
REV-002 HIGH: protected workflow does not prove runner ID 6252/group membership/selected-workflow policy; group+label alone is insufficient.
REV-003 MEDIUM: verifier opens final objects with blocking O_RDONLY before rejecting FIFO/socket/device types.
REV-004 MEDIUM: preflight fixture pins obsolete 6a865d digest instead of the canonical package digest.
next_action: Return to the same Luna code owner for focused remediation and tests, then obtain a fresh independent review of the new exact commit.
